reason: I do my big shop in Jbeil on Saturday mornings already, and with no home delivery I would still have to go and collect it, at their hour, not mine. Paying $2 a bag for that does not make sense when money is tight.
objection: I still have to go out and collect it between 6 and 8 in the evening, so I save no trip, and I pay a fee on top of what I already pay for my groceries.
would_change_my_mind: Delivery to my door, or a pickup point right next to my house, with a proven saving on my weekly basket that is clearly more than the fee.
